request.reason: Declare observed WI-1065 failures, current-base source facts, and high-risk regressions before admission; no implementation or acceptance weakening

changes.value: WI-1065 formal attempts at snapshot sha256:687408271c6c42efa5e581624f9ba9110200ab4d2a3529303b38719eb6925283: first attempt embedded an archived checkout in Cargo test binaries through shared CARGO_TARGET_DIR; second isolated-target attempt passed 27/28 nodes but cockpit-repository package timed out at 300004 ms. Preserve both failed receipts.

origin/main e6636dccb11aa0c98f7d81b01d4d8d5fd32a6ca2 execution_context.rs uses a shared HOME cache target and DEFAULT_EXECUTION_SECONDS=300 for package tests; explicit timeout remains governed by existing policy and maximum 900 seconds.

Direct isolated-target cargo test --locked --package cockpit-repository with RUST_TEST_THREADS=20 passed but required more than 300 seconds; /tmp/wi1065-repository-threads20.log is diagnostic evidence, not a formal Runtime verification receipt.

value.expected: The same repository in distinct linked worktrees gets distinct deterministic default Cargo target directories, preventing test binaries from retaining the other checkout's CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR; an explicit caller target remains unchanged.
value.verificationPlan: RED-to-GREEN repository execution-context regression and an actual two-checkout Cargo test-binary path probe; verify the default path is canonical-checkout-derived and explicit CARGO_TARGET_DIR wins.

value.expected: Only implicit cargo test --package nodes default to 600 seconds; all other implicit commands remain at 300 seconds. Explicit timeouts still require existing project policy, remain at or below 900 seconds, and bounded timeout failures are persisted honestly.
value.verificationPlan: RED-to-GREEN plan/execution regression for package and non-package commands, explicit allowed and rejected overrides, and timeout receipt behavior; run the full declared Runtime verification without skipping a package.

value.expected: The candidate Runtime completes all 13 workspace packages, fmt and Clippy with source-bound receipts; exact-head PR CI retains contract-aware producer, gate, and coverage checks without treating WI-1065's old failed attempts as passed.
value.verificationPlan: Run focused tests and full declared verification on the frozen candidate; inspect exact-head PR CI route, formal receipt, Rust gate, repository gates and workspace coverage before merge; subsequently reverify WI-1065 separately after Runtime update.

acceptanceCriteria: 无显式 CARGO_TARGET_DIR 时，Cargo 验证默认 target 由当前规范化 checkout 路径稳定派生；两个 linked worktree 不共享构建产物，显式 caller target 仍优先，不能引用已归档 worktree 路径。回归覆盖测试二进制 CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR 路径绑定。
无显式 timeout 的 cargo test --package 节点使用有限 600 秒默认，其他命令继续 300 秒；显式 timeout 仍须通过现有 Contract/项目政策上限且不超过 900 秒。执行、计划、失败与超时收据如实记录，不能跳过或复用未通过测试。
先补准确 RED 负例，再做最小 GREEN；格式、Clippy、完整 cargo test --locked --workspace、针对性执行器回归、当前候选 Runtime 的正式验证以及 PR 精确头 CI 均真实通过，保持 13 个 workspace package 完整覆盖。
保留 WI-1065 的两次失败 attempt；本修复合并并更新本地 Runtime 后，在 WI-1065 原 Contract 与专属工作区重新取得正式验证、PR CI 与后续收尾证据，不把本 WI 的绿灯冒充认知评估交付。
